fit_reason: Whole 16 ft power boat with trailer listed by a private owner in the boats by owner section.
findings: Dull, chalky-looking white gelcoat along the port and starboard hull sides
Faded maroon and pink hull stripes along both sides
Grime and dark staining on the white vinyl seats in the cockpit
Dirty, stained maroon carpet on the cockpit floor
Weathered, dingy upholstery on the rear bench and side panels
Dirt and residue on the deck and gunwales around the windshield
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 1988 Forester 160. The hull gelcoat and stripes look faded and chalky, and the cockpit seats and carpet are showing a lot of grime. We do mobile pre-sale details with gelcoat polish and interior cleaning that comes to you, which can really help it show better to buyers. Would you like a quote?
